execution.objective: Propose a bounded authority for issuing a release contract and attempting restoration of the Founder-approved admin dashboard candidate using the verified-feature runner.
success_criteria: Obtain explicit approval and activate a successor authority before any release contract or restoration worktree is created.
Update runner authority binding so it validates the active successor WCS instead of requiring WCS-003.
Bind the release contract and manifest to the exact baseline, candidate, and 11 application paths.
Require the build, targeted API test, and browser test listed in this proposal; stop if any required tool or check is unavailable.
Run restoration only in a runner-created isolated worktree and create a review PR only after all required checks pass.
Require Founder verification of the real signed-in administrator workflows and a read-only Development template fingerprint comparison before any release decision.
Never merge, deploy, publish, or modify database records in this cycle.
execution.verification_profile: SUCCESSOR_AUTHORITY; CONTRACT_BINDING; EXACT_PATH_SCOPE; ISOLATED_RESTORATION; BUILD_API_BROWSER_CHECKS; FOUNDER_VERIFICATION; NO_MERGE_OR_DEPLOY
